title: Concord project tooling declaration
description: Shape of .concord/tooling.v1.json, the per-project record of ready quality tools and checks. scripts/check-project-tooling.py checks repository paths and structural coverage-owner reachability. This is not proof of execution or semantic adequacy; native results and Review own those judgments.

domain_shape.description: Optional Product commands, referenced by existing tool ID. Membership must resolve to tools in this document. No automatic execution or workflow authority. An empty object is visibly unverified.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the manifest.

purpose.description: What the tool checks or does, as one bounded sentence.

invocation.description: The command an agent runs as plain argv. Shell quoting and shell operators are forbidden so the whitespace-split invocation is the exact argv a worktree_verify run must equal (CD-0192). A fact about the tool, not guidance about when to run it.

tier.description: Cost class. fast runs in seconds, standard in minutes, slow beyond that.

cost_hint.description: A bounded single-line estimate or known limit that makes the tier more useful.

config_path.description: Safe repository-relative path of the tool's configuration or entry script. The checker proves that it resolves to a regular file inside the repository.

automation_path.description: Informational safe repository-relative path of related automation. The checker proves path resolution but does not parse the file or infer cadence.

notes.description: Non-obvious constraints an agent needs before running the tool. Facts only.

coverage.description: Optional irreducible anchor-to-executable-owner relations. Existing invocations determine reachability. Structural reachability is not semantic adequacy or actual execution. A selected test is never whole-package evidence. Review judges scenario assertions and generated parity checks.
